note: Planned contracts, not execution receipts. D07/D08 require every adopt_session case; later stages remain mandatory for their named delivery gates and must not be counted as passed in the pilot.

scenarios.name: buried-question
scenarios.given: unrelated progress follows an open decision
scenarios.expected: decision remains open

scenarios.name: unrelated-done
scenarios.given: another step reports done
scenarios.expected: decision and blocked edge remain

scenarios.name: empty-wake-queue
scenarios.given: reconnect with empty event queue
scenarios.expected: all authoritative open decisions appear

scenarios.name: source-disappears
scenarios.given: source cannot be read
scenarios.expected: unknown observation; no implicit clear

scenarios.name: exact-choice
scenarios.given: authenticated choice for current item
scenarios.expected: answer reserved for that subject only

scenarios.name: stale-revision
scenarios.given: answer has old item revision
scenarios.expected: stale_decision; no send

scenarios.name: stale-content
scenarios.given: question content changed
scenarios.expected: hash mismatch; no send

scenarios.name: cross-repo
scenarios.given: valid identity but wrong repository
scenarios.expected: scope_mismatch; no send

scenarios.name: ambiguous-continue
scenarios.given: continue with two open questions
scenarios.expected: ask for the named decision; no send

scenarios.name: forged-actor
scenarios.given: request text claims actor human
scenarios.expected: reject unauthenticated actor

scenarios.name: approval-as-text
scenarios.given: risk approval answered with ordinary text
scenarios.expected: signed_approval_required

scenarios.name: revoked-authority
scenarios.given: grant revoked before resume
scenarios.expected: answer fact retained; no unauthorized execution

scenarios.name: same-key-replay
scenarios.given: same action ID and payload submitted twice
scenarios.expected: one original receipt; no duplicate send

scenarios.name: same-key-conflict
scenarios.given: same action ID but different payload
scenarios.expected: action_conflict

scenarios.name: two-clients
scenarios.given: two windows answer same revision
scenarios.expected: one accepted reservation

scenarios.name: crash-after-reserve
scenarios.given: kill after reservation before observable result
scenarios.expected: qualified reserved row may perform its first dispatch after proof; committed or legacy unknown never resent

scenarios.name: crash-after-send
scenarios.given: effect occurred but receipt not recorded
scenarios.expected: unknown; query exact original action

scenarios.name: unknown-after-restart
scenarios.given: restart with uncertain transport outcome
scenarios.expected: preserve unknown and original identity

scenarios.name: applied-resume
scenarios.given: adapter confirms application for current generation
scenarios.expected: clear only matching edge; observe existing Session

scenarios.name: multiple-obligations
scenarios.given: answer B while C remains open
scenarios.expected: C still blocks its dependent steps

scenarios.name: old-owner
scenarios.given: old controller submits new effect
scenarios.expected: host rejects stale generation

scenarios.name: cancel-versus-answer
scenarios.given: cancel recorded before answer resume
scenarios.expected: no new resume; already sent answer not erased

scenarios.name: quiet-await
scenarios.given: repeated unchanged polls in quiet mode
scenarios.expected: zero model calls; bounded notifications

scenarios.name: defer-not-approve
scenarios.given: user defers to a future time
scenarios.expected: decision remains unanswered; no authority added

scenarios.name: away-not-authority
scenarios.given: user sets away posture
scenarios.expected: same approval restrictions remain

scenarios.name: return-brief
scenarios.given: user returns after progress and an old decision
scenarios.expected: incremental results plus still-open question

scenarios.name: candidate-changed
scenarios.given: tests passed for candidate A but deliver B
scenarios.expected: completion refused

scenarios.name: stop-not-confirmed
scenarios.given: cancel requested but process state unknown
scenarios.expected: no teardown; state is stop_requested/unknown

scenarios.name: clock-backwards
scenarios.given: clock moves backwards
scenarios.expected: no freshness or grant extension

scenarios.name: queue-overload
scenarios.given: bounded queue reaches capacity
scenarios.expected: backpressure; stop and decisions preserved

scenarios.name: wait-cycle
scenarios.given: A waits for B and B waits for A
scenarios.expected: detect cycle with owners; no fabricated answers

scenarios.name: manual-intervention
scenarios.given: human changes Worker task directly
scenarios.expected: needs_reconciliation until exact authorized disposition; no fabricated applied receipt or double resume

scenarios.name: real-harness
scenarios.given: real supported harness receives ordinary answer
scenarios.expected: one original resume; exact action, source and completed turn evidence; this is not full engineering delivery certification

scenarios.name: control-plane-isolation
scenarios.given: worker tries to read keys or mutate approval DB
scenarios.expected: OS boundary denies access

scenarios.name: legacy-approved-contract
scenarios.given: daemon sees historical approved contract without dispatch authorization
scenarios.expected: zero initial Worker dispatches

scenarios.name: cancel-before-commit
scenarios.given: T-cancel commits before T-dispatch
scenarios.expected: no resume call; exact not-dispatched proof or unknown retained

scenarios.name: cancel-after-commit
scenarios.given: T-dispatch commits before T-cancel
scenarios.expected: out-of-band stop request; do not claim no effect or resend

scenarios.name: expired-token-replay
scenarios.given: same authenticated actor repeats same action payload after token expiry
scenarios.expected: read original scoped receipt only; no new write

scenarios.name: immutable-question
scenarios.given: same scoped decision ID is projected with changed content
scenarios.expected: reject content conflict; require new question identity

scenarios.name: daemon-vs-source-generation
scenarios.given: daemon restarts while same worker instance survives
scenarios.expected: new daemon can query old action; source identity unchanged; no resend

scenarios.name: applied-is-completed-turn
scenarios.given: resume started but next turn is still running
scenarios.expected: show running only with evidence; do not show applied or require prior wait clearance

scenarios.name: source-advanced-without-proof
scenarios.given: latest turn changed without exact decision disposition evidence
scenarios.expected: needs_reconciliation; not automatic supersession

scenarios.name: worker-flock-is-insufficient
scenarios.given: main PID gone and worktree lock released but child still writes
scenarios.expected: refuse quiescence proof and replacement writer

scenarios.name: released-lineage
scenarios.given: upgrade canonical main schema 46 and separately an unmatched experimental schema
scenarios.expected: canonical upgrade succeeds; experimental mismatch refused without mutation

scenarios.name: qualification-forgery
scenarios.given: well-shaped record has forged signature or missing evidence object
scenarios.expected: future runtime rejects activation; schema validation alone is insufficient

scenarios.name: qualification-profile-mismatch
scenarios.given: macOS qualified record supplied for Linux or different adapter
scenarios.expected: no qualified route

scenarios.name: observed-cost-not-hard-cap
scenarios.given: provider lacks enforceable token bound and usage is lost
scenarios.expected: cost remains unknown/observed; no unsupported hard-cap claim

scenarios.name: principal-replay-scope
scenarios.given: another principal repeats known action ID or token/body differ
scenarios.expected: no receipt disclosure and no write

scenarios.name: legacy-action-phase
scenarios.given: old accepted message has no dispatch phase proof
scenarios.expected: legacy_unknown; cannot mark not_dispatched or auto-resend

scenarios.name: adoption-pilot-no-registry
scenarios.given: adopt existing admitted Session with runtime registry absent
scenarios.expected: complete decision journey without new Worker or R/E dependencies

scenarios.name: restart-first-dispatch
scenarios.given: new gated protocol reserved with v+1 persisted, valid original source, no stop and exclusive admission
scenarios.expected: one original CAS and resume; committed or legacy messages never retried

scenarios.name: dispatch-admission-fails
scenarios.given: admission denied before phase CAS
scenarios.expected: phase stays reserved; no adapter call; no fabricated failed receipt

scenarios.name: cancelled-phase-migration
scenarios.given: baseline schema 46 upgraded and verified cancellation proof stored
scenarios.expected: lineage passes; old resolution CHECK unchanged; new session instruction is not blocked by proven cancelled message

scenarios.name: all-entrances-gated
scenarios.given: two engineering/attention/session entrances race for one phase row
scenarios.expected: one CAS winner and at most one resume; direct helper call without permit rejected

scenarios.name: source-native-replaced
scenarios.given: same session row changes native ID or native ID becomes NULL
scenarios.expected: old Mission enters reconciliation; no rebinding or send

scenarios.name: dispose-without-action
scenarios.given: authenticated mission.steer actor binds current snapshot and exact wait with no pending action
scenarios.expected: superseded observation dependency; steering receipt; no session message or applied proof

scenarios.name: dispose-with-unknown-action
scenarios.given: user requests wait disposal while original send is unknown
scenarios.expected: reject disposal and preserve unknown receipt; stop/read/query remain available

scenarios.name: observed-turn-success
scenarios.given: own exact reply applied, same latest turn idle/completed, no waits, cancellation or pending effects
scenarios.expected: completed with ObservationProof only; no code/test delivery assertion

scenarios.name: historical-run-terminal
scenarios.given: Run completed before adoption while Session still awaits decision
scenarios.expected: no Mission success; Run terminal is insufficient

scenarios.name: end-observation
scenarios.given: out-of-band handling leaves no owned applied receipt and user explicitly ends observation
scenarios.expected: observation_ended not success; no resume/stop effect; unresolved responsibilities remain addressable

scenarios.name: signer-role-confusion
scenarios.given: ci_verifier key signs host_verified or revocation epoch is rolled back
scenarios.expected: future verifier rejects regardless of payload role

scenarios.name: cancelled-original-item
scenarios.given: original action known cancelled and user retries or changes answer on same item
scenarios.expected: original cancelled receipt or immutable conflict; explicit limitation, no new action or fabricated question ID

scenarios.name: resolution-before-dispatch
scenarios.given: phase reserved but exact message has abandoned_unknown resolution
scenarios.expected: zero dispatch; preserve resolution and reconcile conflicting phase

scenarios.name: reserved-projection-recovery
scenarios.given: new gated reserved action recovered after crash without resolution
scenarios.expected: projection remains reserved, not uncertain; all other dispatch preconditions still required

scenarios.name: abandon-reserved-rejected
scenarios.given: abandon receipt invoked for reserved phase, then explicit cancel committed
scenarios.expected: abandon itself refuses without writing/sending; cancel creates barrier and prevents first dispatch

scenarios.name: steering-owner-only
scenarios.given: different principal has scope write but is not adopt owner
scenarios.expected: dispose_wait refused; owner also refused if current scope permission revoked
